method.method_draft: Read the instruction to ignore arrows and exclude bonds involving hydrogen. From the image, count the non-hydrogen bonds individually: R-C on the left, C-X, C-S, S=O to the first oxygen, S=O to the second oxygen, S-C on the right, and C-R1. Do not count the C-H bond or any arrow to/from B. The total is 7.
